name: hotel-booking-agent

dependencies.name: hotel-booking-api
dependencies.description: Search hotels/rooms and create, list and cancel the caller's bookings.

description: The traveler's whole front door: a conversational agent that takes destination/dates/preferences, searches and compares hotels and rooms via hotel-booking-api, and books, pays for, lists and cancels the traveler's own reservations. Holds no business data itself beyond its own conversation store.
